goal: Keyboard chart marks (K7): clickable bars and donut slices are reachable by Tab, show a focus ring, and Enter/Space act as a click.

acceptance_criteria.text: dashboard.js: crossFilter is split into apply(c, value) (today's URL toggle) called by plotly_click and the keyboard; keyboardMarks(plot, c) (same MutationObserver pattern as keyboardBar) runs only when clickable(c) and gives each trace-0 bar path and each donut slice path tabindex=0, role=button and aria-label '<x_label>: <category>'; the grey Other trace and last-level non-clickable leaderboard bars get none

Enter or Space on a mark calls apply with the category from the trace by index (horizontal bars y[i], vertical x[i], donut labels[i]) with the same URL, chip and count change as a click; the mark shows a visible focus ring (outline from DESIGN.md: 3px --fg, offset 2px)

Playwright (tests/test_keyboard_marks.py) on Explorer bars and donut, Business leaderboard, Survey question bars and Map top-region bars: Tab reaches a mark, getComputedStyle outline width > 0 when focused, Enter filters, Space filters
python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_keyboard_marks.py tests/test_filter_browser.py tests/test_business_page.py passes

decisions.what: Map top-region bars get no keyboard stop; the Map test asserts none
decisions.why: geo.py sets drill False for them (gate 179), clickable() rejects them, and test_geo/test_map_page assert no click or pointer; making them clickable is a backend and test change beyond this ticket

decisions.what: Category is taken from the Plotly point's trace index (group __data__.i), falling back to DOM order, then looked up in plot.data[0]
decisions.why: Pie slices are sorted by Plotly, so DOM order may differ from labels[i]
The 3px --fg outline at 2px offset on .point path and .slice path already exists

tried_and_failed.what: Test on places.csv that Tab reaches a top-region mark and Enter filters
tried_and_failed.why_it_failed: The Map regions figure has data-drill=false, so there are no marks to reach

assumptions: AC-85's 'clickable chart mark' means marks that actually click today, so non-clickable Map regions satisfy it with no stop
The Space check on the filtered page needs the same mark focused, so the test focuses it by aria-label after the reload
open_questions: Should Map top regions become clickable (geo.py drill True plus edits to test_geo.py and test_map_page.py) so the ticket's Map line holds? ARCHITECTURE AC-85 lists places top regions but also says data-drill=false stays non-clickable.
The full suite was not run by me; I only ran the ticket's three files and six related page tests.

lessons.lesson: Before writing a browser test for a mark on a page, probe whether that figure is clickable (data-drill, filter select present); acceptance text can list figures that are deliberately inert
lessons.when: A ticket asks for interaction on figures from several apps
lessons.evidence: Map regions figure has data-drill=false so MARKS was 0 in the probe

lessons.lesson: A drilling leaderboard shows a different column after Enter, so test the second step by pressing Space on a mark of the next level, not by toggling the same value off
lessons.when: Testing keyboard or click filters on the Business leaderboard
